projects.title: Aurum Atelier
projects.summary: A quiet, gallery-like storefront concept for a fine jewellery label.
projects.overview: A demonstration storefront exploring how a luxury product range can be browsed like an exhibition rather than a catalogue.
projects.context: Concept brief: a heritage jeweller moving its in-store experience online.
projects.goals: Let each piece breathe, keep checkout effortless, and make enquiries one tap away.
projects.approach: Warm black canvas, editorial serif headings, slow image reveals and a restrained gold accent.

projects.title: Northline Architects
projects.summary: An editorial portfolio concept for an architecture practice.
projects.overview: A sample studio website where large photography and precise typography carry the narrative.
projects.context: Concept brief: a practice that wins work through referrals and needs a credible digital presence.
projects.goals: Present projects with clarity, show the studio's thinking and route visitors to an enquiry.
projects.approach: Strict grid, generous whitespace, cool stone palette, and scroll-led project chapters.

projects.title: Orbit Labs
projects.summary: A real-time 3D product reveal concept for a hardware launch.
projects.overview: A sample launch site that uses an interactive 3D object as the centrepiece of the story.
projects.context: Concept brief: a product team launching a new device and wanting the website to feel like the unveiling.
projects.goals: Make the product tangible online and guide visitors from curiosity to pre-order.
projects.approach: Deep navy stage, controlled studio lighting and camera moves tied to scroll.

projects.title: Verde Kitchen
projects.summary: A warm single-page concept for a neighbourhood restaurant.
projects.overview: A sample landing page that turns menu, story and reservations into one appetising scroll.
projects.context: Concept brief: a restaurant relying on Instagram that wants direct bookings.
projects.goals: Show the food, share the menu, and make reserving a table immediate.
projects.approach: Herb-green palette, hand-set headlines and a sticky reservation action.

projects.title: Meridian Supply
projects.summary: A structured product catalogue concept for a B2B supplier.
projects.overview: A sample catalogue where hundreds of SKUs stay easy to browse, compare and enquire about.
projects.context: Concept brief: a supplier currently sharing PDF catalogues over WhatsApp.
projects.goals: Replace PDFs with a searchable catalogue and quote-request flow.
projects.approach: Clean technical layout, strong filtering and spec tables.

projects.title: Ledgerly
projects.summary: A calm dashboard concept for small-business bookkeeping.
projects.overview: A sample web application exploring how financial data can feel approachable.
projects.context: Concept brief: owners who find accounting software intimidating.
projects.goals: Surface what matters first and make routine tasks quick.
projects.approach: Soft dark interface, clear hierarchy and purposeful micro-interactions.
